```{=typst}
#let mk(n) = box(baseline: 22%, circle(radius: 5.8pt, fill: rgb("#d9480f"), stroke: none, inset: 0pt)[#set align(center + horizon); #text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8pt)[#n]])
#let tick = box(baseline: 12%, width: 10pt, height: 10pt, stroke: 0.9pt + luma(70), radius: 2pt)
#let shot(path, w: 100%) = block(breakable: false, stroke: 0.8pt + luma(150), radius: 6pt, clip: true, image(path, width: w))
#let typebox(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#f1f6fd"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 5pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt), body)
#let tip(body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, fill: rgb("#fff4e6"), stroke: (left: 3pt + rgb("#d9480f")), inset: (x: 10pt, y: 7pt), radius: 3pt, body)
// One step: the box to tick, its number and what to do on the left; its screen on the right.
#let step(n, body, img: none, w: 100%, left: 40%, after: none) = block(breakable: false, above: 9pt, below: 9pt, width: 100%)[
  #set par(justify: false, leading: 0.62em)
  #let words = grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, [#tick #h(1pt) *#n.*], body)
  #if img == none { words } else {
    grid(columns: (left, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt, align: (top, top), words, align(center, shot(img, w: w)))
  }
  #if after != none { v(4pt); after }
]
```

::: {.lead}
Today you make a **post** for Mona's Cakes in **PowerPoint**: one slide with the message, the call to action and a picture, saved as a picture to share. Do the tasks in order. The **orange
numbers** in each picture show where to click. Tick the box `#tick`{=typst} after each step. Stuck? Raise your hand.
:::

- **You need:** a lab computer with PowerPoint. **Nothing to download:**
  you type the text yourself.
- **Time:** about 35 minutes. Your PowerPoint may look a little different:
  the names of the buttons are the same.

## Task 1 · The message and the call to action

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click *Search* on the taskbar #mk(1). Type *powerpoint*. Click *PowerPoint* #mk(2).], img: "images/lab-open-1.png", w: 80%, left: 32%)
#step(2, [Click *Blank Presentation* #mk(1).], img: "images/lab-open-2.png", w: 36%, left: 32%)
#step(3, [Click in *Click to add title* #mk(1) and type the message: #h(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Fresh cakes for your party!] \ Click in *Click to add subtitle* #mk(2) and type the call to action: #h(2pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#185abd"), radius: 4pt, inset: 4pt)[Order today on our website]], img: "images/lab-post-1.png", w: 100%, left: 42%)
```

## Task 2 · A theme

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click the *Design* tab #mk(1). Click a theme with strong colours #mk(2).], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-post-2.png", w: 88%)))
```

## Task 3 · A picture: an icon

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Click the *Insert* tab #mk(1). Click *Icons* #mk(2). \ Type *cake* in the search box #mk(3). Click an icon #mk(4). Click *Insert* #mk(5). \ Drag the icon to a free corner of the slide. \ #text(size: 9pt, fill: luma(80))[No Icons in your PowerPoint? Use *Insert › Shapes*: a star.]], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-post-3.png", w: 88%)))
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak(weak: true)
```

## Task 4 · Save the post, then save it as a picture

```{=typst}
#step(1, [Press *F12*. Click *Desktop* #mk(1). Type *post-* and your first name #mk(2). Click *Save* #mk(3).], img: "images/lab-save-1.png", w: 92%, left: 34%)
#step(2, [Press *F12* again. *Save as type*: *PNG Portable Network Graphics* #mk(2). Click *Save* #mk(3), then *Just This One*. \ *post-….png* is a picture, ready to share.], img: "images/lab-save-2.png", w: 92%, left: 34%)
```

## Extra · AI adds a slide of prices to your post

```{=typst}
#block(width: 100%, fill: rgb("#e3f4f1"), stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 6pt, inset: (x: 12pt, y: 9pt))[
  Only when you finish Tasks 1–4. On *tutudocs.com* an *AI assistant* changes your PowerPoint file for you. *No sign-in.*
]
#step(1, [Open the browser. Go to *tutudocs.com*.])
#step(2, [Click the box *Drop a file anywhere on this page, or click to choose* #mk(1). \ Click *Desktop*, click your file *post-…*, click *Open*. \ Your post opens in the online editor.], img: "images/lab-tutu-1.png", w: 84%, left: 36%)
#step(3, [Click *AI Assistant* at the top #mk(1). \ Click in *Ask AI anything…* #mk(2) and type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 4pt, inset: 5pt)[Add a second slide with our three cakes and their prices.] \ Press *Enter* #mk(3). Wait about 15 seconds: a new slide comes.], after: align(center, shot("images/lab-tutu-2.png", w: 84%)))
#step(4, [One more request. Type: #h(3pt) #box(fill: white, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#8fd1c4"), radius: 4pt, inset: 5pt)[Make the title red.] \ Press *Enter*. Wait for the answer before you type again.])
#step(5, [Click *File* #mk(1), then *Download* #mk(2), then the choice that ends in *.pptx* #mk(3). \ Open the new file from *Downloads*: it opens in PowerPoint, with the changes of the AI.], img: "images/lab-tutu-3.png", w: 74%, left: 44%)
```
